name: 44843 · Lucas, OH
findings: ZIP 44843 (Lucas) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (90%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 44843 (Lucas) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 44843 (Lucas) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.9 times the typical level).
